CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE gold.FactTable
WITH
(
    LOCATION='FactOrders',
    DATA_SOURCE=gold,
    FILE_FORMAT=parquet_format
)
AS
SELECT
    O.DimOrdersKey,
    C.DimCustomerKey,
    P.DimProductKey,
    G.DimGeoKey,
    F.Quantity,
    F.UnitPrice,
    F.TotalAmount
FROM silver.SilverTable AS F

LEFT JOIN gold.dimorders AS O
    ON F.OrderID = O.OrderID

LEFT JOIN gold.dimcustomer AS C
    ON F.CustomerID = C.CustomerID

LEFT JOIN gold.dimproduct AS P
    ON F.ProductID = P.ProductID

LEFT JOIN gold.dimgeo AS G
    ON F.RegionID = G.RegionID
   AND F.Country = G.Country;
